objectives:
“This course is intend to integrate various technologies in characterizing semiconductor materials as well as devices.
It presents more 10 characterization techniques and related theories whose contents composes a wide spectrum of knowledge including electrical, optical, chemical, and physical.
The course is particularly useful for senior undergraduate and graduate students who intend to join the semiconductor industry.“
content:
0. 課程介紹 (1週)

1.電學特性量測分析 (3週)
原理介紹: Resistivity and concentration
實驗: 霍爾效應 (Hall Effect) / 四點探針 (4 point measurement)

2.半導體光學量測分析 (4週)?
原理介紹??實驗: 量子井光激光譜 (Photoluminescence)?

?3.太陽電池與光偵測器 (5 週)?
原理介紹??太陽電池製程與光偵測器製程?
實驗: 光偵測器量測 (光電流/響應度)

4. 熱傳播量測分析(3週)
原理介紹
實驗: 薄膜熱傳導係數量測
